baseline_trust.description: How far absence answers of the baseline view were trusted.

mode.description: The mode the broker scanned in.

scan_id.description: The scan, for the next requests.

timings.description: The broker's timing marks (M3_DESIGN.md §9.1): for measurement only; a client ignores it.

BaselineTrust.description:
How far a baseline view can be trusted when it says "this key is not Windows' own"
(BASELINE_LOCAL_DESIGN.md §4.1). Serialised by its variant name.

Presence ("Windows has it") blocks at every level. Absence is *proof* only at [`BaselineTrust::Exact`];
at `Merged` and `Local` it is *inferred* and under the trust cap (invariant L4: it never makes an item
Safe or preselected); at `None` it is never answered.

oneOf.description: A shipped baseline matches the host's (edition, build, ubr): absence is proof, as at the M1b gate.
No exact match; a complete local baseline merged with at least one shipped neighbour.
No exact match and no neighbour; a complete local baseline alone.
Anything else: absence is never answered, the scan works values-only.

ScanMode.description: The situation a leftover scan runs in (ENGINE_PLAN.md §5.1).

oneOf.description: Right after the vendor uninstaller ran under Purge, with a pre-uninstall harvest.
The app was uninstalled outside Purge; only a cached harvest, if any, is available.
No uninstaller ran (forced removal of a broken or portable app).

ms.description: Milliseconds since the broker process was created, on a monotonic clock.

wall_unix_ms.description: The wall clock at the mark, milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

TimingName.description: A step of the elevated flow the broker times.

oneOf.description: `main` passed the DLL-search and working-directory restriction (process mark).
The client passed the pipe checks and its `engine.hello` was answered (process mark).
`uninstall.prepare` harvested every program, stored each fingerprint and opened the sessions.
The first `*.progress` line of the request was written to the pipe.
`leftovers.scan` built its scan and counted the bands.
The consent dialog was up and could be answered.
`plan.execute` handed the approved plan to the executor.

Timings.description: The `timings` member of a result: for measurement only (M3_DESIGN.md §9.1); a client ignores it.

marks.description: The process marks, then the marks of this request, in the order they were taken.

process_created_unix_ms.description:
When the broker process was created (`GetProcessTimes`), milliseconds since the Unix epoch;
absent when it could not be read (the marks then count from the broker's own start).

Warning.description: A warning for the user. `code` is stable for the client to switch on; `message` is shown.
